operators.name: affine_grid_scaled
semantics: Generates an affine grid using torch.affine_grid_generator(theta, [N, 2, size_h, size_w], align_corners=align_corners), then multiplies every element by scale (broadcast scalar).
For each batch n and output position (h, w), compute base grid coordinates using align_corners semantics, then grid[n,h,w,0] = base_x * scale and grid[n,h,w,1] = base_y * scale.
If align_corners is True, coordinates linearly interpolate from -1 to 1 inclusive at corners; else they interpolate from -1+1/H to 1-1/H (or similar PyTorch convention).
Output tensor is contiguous float32 CUDA tensor of shape [N, size_h, size_w, 2].
Actual computation: generate affine grid from theta and size=[512,2,256,256] with align_corners=True.
Output shape [512,256,256,2], dtype float32, device cuda:0, stride [131072,512,2,1].
No bias, no broadcasting beyond batch-wise affine transformation.
Multiply each element of grid by scalar scale=0.5 (broadcast).
Output shape [512,256,256,2], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
